title: SelectChannel CH0-fallback threshold revision
description: Current SelectChannel density>10→CH0 collapses all data traffic onto control channel at high density, which is counter-productive. Raise threshold to density>50 or replace with interference-score-based trigger. Requires regenerating ccp16.json and ccp15.json test vectors. Spec: 02a-coordinated-capacity.md §2a.3.1 dense deployment note. All three impls + test vectors.
